title: Juicy British Lamb Roast
description: A traditional English dish featuring a fatty and flavorful lamb roast with rosemary, perfect for a special occasion. This recipe is satvik-friendly and uses a brine-dry method to enhance the flavor.

ingredients.name: lamb roast
ingredients.notes: preferably with a good layer of fat

instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the olive oil, salt, black pepper, and garlic.
Rub the mixture all over the lamb roast, making sure to coat it evenly.
Place the lamb roast in a large roasting pan and put it in the oven.
Roast the lamb for 20 minutes per pound, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
After 30 minutes of roasting, add the rosemary sprigs to the pan.
Baste the lamb with the pan juices every 20 minutes to keep it moist.
Once the lamb is cooked, remove it from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing.
Drizzle the lemon juice over the lamb before serving.
